scientific_integrity: The all-degree statements have a symbolic algebraic proof; a finite modular checker corroborates graded dimensions through finitely many degrees and is not an infinite certificate. The named reduced plane and distinguished conic are established prior results, not new discoveries.
scientific_limitations: Theorem concerns only the standard classical Perazzo cubic in characteristic different from two. Jacobian scheme, not the apolar Artinian algebra; no classification of all Perazzo forms or characteristic-two specialization. An unindexed classical account of this exact computation cannot be excluded.
title: The embedded theta line in the Perazzo cubic's Jacobian scheme
